name: smplixit
description: Adaptive health literacy engine for hospital discharge instructions

postcss: Next 14 bundles its own postcss copy, pinned below the version that fixes
GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q and GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93. Both are build-time source-map
and stringify issues rather than runtime request paths, and every CSS input
in this repo is first-party. The override lifts the nested copy to a patched
release instead of moving the app to Next 16, which would change the App
Router surface the product is built on.
Revisit when a Next 14.2.x release ships the patched dependency.
